initial_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent production sprite atlas for a side-view 2D fighter. Exactly EIGHT complete isolated full-body poses facing RIGHT in a regular 4 column by 2 row grid, one pose in each cell. Top row: idle daggers guard, walking stride, crossed-daggers defensive block, airborne jump. Bottom row: quick dagger thrust, sweeping heavy dagger slash, orange afterimage dash-slash special, recoiling hurt. SAME body height and costume throughout. Canvas square 1280x1280, logical cells320x640; keep each whole pose AND weapons inside its cell with ample transparent padding at least40pixels horizontally. Genuine transparent alpha background, no text, no letters, no grid or labels, no ground shadows, no extra characters.
